answer_sql:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(order_date) AS as_of
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CAST((
    ref.as_of - s.open_date
  ) AS INT) / 365.25), 2) AS average_age_years
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
CROSS JOIN ref
WHERE
  s.close_date IS NULL AND s.is_online = FALSE
